name: VNX British Pound
oneLiner: VGBP is VNX's Liechtenstein-licensed pound sterling stablecoin redeemable 1:1, backed by GBP cash in Swiss and Liechtenstein bank accounts.
collateral: GBP deposits held in bank accounts in Switzerland and Liechtenstein, confirmed 1:1 by Areva General Auditing and Trust Company Limited (December 2024)
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 redemption through VNX Commodities AG; tokens minted on demand for verified customers depositing equivalent GBP value

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At the 2026-07-13 cutoff, the Base and Celo VNXCToken deployments assigned asset-protection role 0 to issuer-controlled RBAC bearers; that role can freeze and unfreeze addresses, reclaim balances, and pause transfers. The Solana mint separately had freeze authority 51b5UJs8hyyDunrZMWL6ACDXY8FQc1hLLA3M54UksxaY. These are direct on-chain blacklist or equivalent freeze controls, not a governance inference.

mintAuthority.summary: VGBP has three independently mintable native deployments. Base and Celo use VNXCToken proxies whose chain-local VNXManager role-0 bearers can grant the minter role and set arbitrary per-minter allowances with no delay; 0xd630...051f already has a 1 billion VGBP allowance on each chain. Solana uses the classic SPL Token program with one unrestricted mint authority. No on-chain multisig, timelock, global supply cap, or disclosed MPC/HSM custody was found at the exact cutoff.

controls.label: VGBP Base direct minter and role-0 bearer
controls.capDescription: Current raw allowance is 1e27, equal to 1 billion VGBP at 18 decimals; the same address can reset its allowance through role 0.
controls.evidence: At Base block 48592766 this EOA held minter role 2 and role 0, with a positive 1e27 raw allowance. One signature can mint within that allowance or use role 0 to configure an arbitrary replacement allowance. On-chain data does not establish whether the issuer uses MPC or HSM custody.

controls.label: VGBP Solana mint and freeze authority
controls.capDescription: Classic SPL Token mint authority; no supply cap or mint allowance is enforced.
bypassSurfaces: The authority can rotate the mint and freeze authorities without a timelock.
controls.evidence: At finalized Solana slot 432714278 (block height 410782389, hash 2zmgf9eoeHxnc8cU4jzyYSRPi8RkxAXhPWutQwR9w9ZS), this on-curve System Program account was both mint and freeze authority. One signature can mint without an on-chain cap. All two later mint-address transactions through the audit cutoff were checked and contained no authority mutation, so the state projects back to the exact slot. On-chain data does not establish whether the issuer uses MPC or HSM custody.

controls.label: VGBP deployment-wide upgrade authorities
bypassSurfaces: On Base and Celo, proxy-admin owner 0xd630...051f can use the inherited changeProxyAdmin path.
On Base and Celo, either role-0 bearer can grant itself proxy-admin role 1 and call upgrade or upgradeAndCall.
The Solana Token program is immutable, but its mint authority can rotate itself.
controls.evidence: The Base and Celo proxies each use chain-local VNXProxyAdmin 0xa5d680c17abcd0df3b9b4d5a7c7d1cae0051dcb4, owned by 0xd630...051f. Role 1 can upgrade, and role 0 administers role 1; role-0 bearers are 0xd630...051f and 0xacc5...311a on both chains. Each listed bearer is an EOA and one bearer can reach an upgrade path with no delay. Solana Tokenkeg ProgramData 3gvYRKWyXRR9xKWe1ZjPhLY5ZJRN7KDB4rFZFGoJfFk2 has null upgrade authority.

review.evidence: Exact-cutoff state was reconstructed at 2026-07-13T20:34:40Z from Base block 48592766, Celo block 72074122, and finalized Solana slot 432714278. Base role changes at blocks 48323261, 48323271, 48323282, 48323293, and allowance update 48323563 occurred before the cutoff and explain why the previous manager/admin inventory was stale. Storage, role membership, token allowances, EIP-1967 implementation/admin/beacon slots, account ownership, and post-slot Solana mint transactions were checked. All three independent mint paths and all immediate authorization or upgrade bypasses are represented above; EVM and Solana issuer keys are single-account controls on-chain, while off-chain MPC/HSM custody remains unknown.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: VGBP has issuer-controlled deployments across its listed chains, and the reviewed mint-authority data resolves direct VNX issuer minting on Base. No separate bridge, lockbox, or liquidity route was resolved, so Pharos treats current route risk as native issuance on supported chains.
